instruction: Play the HBO Max original series 'House of the Dragon' from your purchased library in VLC.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because HBO Max (Max) content is protected by Widevine DRM. VLC cannot decrypt or play DRM-protected content from HBO Max, regardless of whether it's purchased or subscribed.
